verdict.rationale: Linear's own docs say users can "Build agents that can investigate incidents, monitor SLAs, or analyze customer feedback." Loops let users describe a job in plain language and set it to run on a schedule or on an event, and shared skills standardize workflows. Its agent developer platform also supports custom agents for internal use that can be assigned and mentioned like workspace users. missing for 10: detail on configuring an agent's persona, instructions, tools or model inside the product; any community or hands-on confirmation that building custom agents works; clarity on whether custom agents run natively in Linear or must be hosted externally through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build and configure my own custom AI agent within the product
